name: sphinx-preview
description: Build and preview Sphinx documentation with live reload.

sphinxPreview.sourceDirectory.description: Directory containing the Sphinx conf.py, relative to the project root. Supports ${workspaceFolder}.

sphinxPreview.outputDirectory.description: Directory for generated HTML. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${projectRoot}, and ${documentationRoot}. Relative paths are resolved from the project root.

sphinxPreview.pipIndexUrl.description: Python package index used to initialize the documentation virtual environment. Leave empty to use the user's pip configuration.

sphinxPreview.plantUmlJarPath.description: Optional path to plantuml.jar. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${projectRoot}, and ${documentationRoot}. Leave empty to use the path from conf.py.

sphinxPreview.preBuildCommands.description: PowerShell commands to run once before the preview server starts. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${projectRoot}, and ${documentationRoot}. A command failure prevents startup.

sphinxPreview.postBuildCommands.description: PowerShell commands to run once after the initial preview becomes available. Supports ${workspaceFolder}, ${projectRoot}, and ${documentationRoot}. A command failure leaves the preview running.

sphinxPreview.host.description: Host interface used by the preview server.

sphinxPreview.port.description: Port used by the preview server.

sphinxPreview.powerShellPath.description: PowerShell executable used to run the preview script.

sphinxPreview.openOnStart.description: Open the preview in VS Code after the server becomes ready.
